messages:
Alex: Thinking of starting a stealth nap club. No formal meetings, just a polite 20–30min snooze in Conf Room C at 2pm. 'Quiet hour' sign required? :zzz:
Maria: LOL yes. How do we sign up? Is this a bring-your-own-blanket situation? :blanket:
Jamal: Count me in if there are cookies after. Otherwise I'll just nap under my desk like a savage. :joy:
Sophia: I can make a tiny 'Do Not Disturb — Power Saver Mode' sign. Pro-tip: eye masks from the merch closet. :sunglasses:
CoffeeBot: Heads up — caffeine levels might drop post-nap. Suggestion: 12:30pm espresso for interested participants. :coffee: (recommended by CoffeeBot)
Leo: Maybe rotate days so Conf Room C isn't permanently occupied. Also please respect 30-min rule so afternoon meetings survive.
Alex: Plan: sign-up sheet in Google Drive + first-come-first-served. If more than 4 people, we'll alternate. Jamal you bring the snacks. :grin:
Jamal: I will buy miniature croissants. Also propose a snoring leaderboard (friendly, optional). :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Sophia: Please no snoring public shaming. But a 'most restful nap' ribbon is allowed.
Maria: Quick poll: who wants Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday/Friday slots? Reply with the day you prefer.
Alex: Also pinging @Facilities? to make sure Conf Room C is OK for short naps (no scheduled pushes).
Leo: I'll make a shared doc. For now, reply here with day and approx time. I'll collate.
Maria: Tuesday 2pm for me.
Jamal: Wednesday 2pm.
Sophia: Friday 2pm, because Friday naps are premium. :trophy:
Alex: Tuesday for me.
CoffeeBot: Reminder set: Tuesday 1:50pm 'Nap club warm-up stretch' (bot humour).
Leo: Cool. I'm slotting an initial roster. Will post Drive link in the thread when it's ready. :link:
Maria: Excited. Secret handshake to follow. :eyes:
